en.text:
The <solar/>Sol Invictus buff you receive from <solar/>Sunspots lasts twice as long (5⁠🠚⁠10 seconds).

<solar/>Sunspots you create gain new visuals and now benefit allies, granting them the <solar/>Sol Invictus buff for 10 seconds.

<solar/>Sunspots can be extended by up to 2? seconds by dealing sustained Solar Weapon Damage (seems to not work without the Aspect, and only extends by 2 seconds).

Granting <solar/>Solar Buffs to allies 3-5 times spawns a <solar/>Sunspot under the user.
